column1: # One vector file, three consumers: the image's host self-test (C matcher),
# every suite judge's --selftest (Python matcher) and the build-time review of
# board_select_match (C) and select_names (Python).  A line is a match vector
# when its first field is a directive ("only="/"skip="); a case name can never
# start that way, so the two kinds share one file without ambiguity.  These pin
# the console prerequisite: whatever the directive says, "shell-up" stays
# selected - an `only=` that dropped it left a board round with no shell and
# mis-graded the missing console commands as a join failure.
